pr_title: Fix failure to check result of bn_rshift_fixed_top
pr_comments:
Three way merged.

The tagging bot didn't find this one.

issue_context.title: Division incorrect result on allocation failure
issue_context.body:
Return value of bn_rshift_fixed_top is not checked:
https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/9c140a33663f319ad4000a6a985c3e14297c7389/crypto/bn/bn_div.c#L450

That function can fail if an allocation failure occurs:
https://github.com/openssl/openssl/blob/9c140a33663f319ad4000a6a985c3e14297c7389/crypto/bn/bn_shift.c#L198-L199

This can cause BN_div to produce an incorrect result.

review_comments:
Just and FYI really.

`!bn_rshift_fixed_top()` is okay here -- it's returning a 0/1 value.

A better habit, given the number of times it's tripped us up, might be `<= 0`.

No need for either change, this is good as it is.
